A dumping ground for everything that isn't a standalone comic. I'll keep characters from the same series grouped together, and textless variants will follow immediately after sets where applicable.

12/17/25: Initial upload.
1/7/26: Added old Monster Girl set. Lower quality than usual, but I put it on Pixiv and I fucking refuse to not have uncensored variants available somewhere.
1/9/26: Added 1000 Pixiv follower milestone Lapis Lazuli set. This is beginning to develop into an actual comic and might get its own gallery eventually. I'll probably wait until it's developed a bit more, and keep putting images in that set here for now.
3/9/26: Added miscellaneous images that I uploaded to Pixiv recently. Also made a separate gallery for the full Lapis Lazuli set, linked here: https://e-hentai.org/g/3829980/a00559470b/
5/22/26: Added uncensored versions of an image dump from Pixiv. Includes content for Ankha, Connie, Dua Lipa, Isabelle, Anne (Runaway Girl from JoJo), and Lofi Girl. Sorted accordingly to keep characters together.
